about: The screen's own wording: every string the screen shows that the workbook does not print, sorted into two tiers (decided 2 October 2026). tools/check-wording.mjs fails on a string the screen marks as its own and this list does not hold, and on a listed string no longer found. Lines are refreshed with node tools/check-wording.mjs --lines.

tiers.method: Says something about the participant's work: warnings, field labels, findings, instructions, return and review messages, and the canvas reports. Ashley approves each one; until then each stays marked as provisional.
tiers.controls: Buttons, navigation, saving notices, empty states, and the names a screen reader reads. Approved as a block under the rule in CLAUDE.md, "Wording the screen's controls", once Ashley approves that rule (a draft of 2 October 2026); until then they stay marked as provisional. meetsRule says whether a control already meets the draft rule, and suggestion gives wording that would.

how.marked: Marked with Prov in a view: shown with a dotted underline.
how.definition: Marked provisional: true in a step definition or page 25: shown with a dotted underline.
how.literal: Shown with a dotted underline through a variable; listed by a piece of the source.
how.dialog: A browser dialog, which cannot carry the underline.
how.attribute: An aria-label, title, or placeholder: read by a screen reader or shown as a tooltip, not underlined.
